prompt: a breakbeat piece built on the sliced demo loop, showing every way the sample part can cut it

requests.ask: make a much more interesting example song

changes.why: the loop as recorded, eight equal slices, filtered and far off so the break is the whole arrangement
halves: bar two swaps for a repeat of bar one every other pass, and the square bass enters on the octave leap
the trimmed second bar only (begin .5) quartered, at its own bpm 99 so the break drops in pitch and gets heavy
quarters with one step doubled and the last alternating; fx riser into the climax and the marimba answers undertow's question
break points isolating the first kick and the first snare, played syncopated with stretch so the long slice is squeezed; piano hook, glockenspiel counter-line, impact on the downbeat
the same eight slices with all but two deleted, space .9: the tide out
